text:
Ava (People Ops): Heads-up — launching a Commuter Flex program + shuttle pilot for SF & PDX hubs starting Mon May 5. TL;DR: $100/mo flexible transit stipend (pro-rated for May) for eligible employees + an optional free shuttle in SF (two AM runs, two PM returns). Signup required by Apr 28. Form: https://forms.redwood.example/commuter-flex :paperclip:

TransitBot: Calendar event created: "Commuter Shuttle - SF (May 5 onward)" — recurring weekdays 07:30 & 08:30 departures, returns 18:00 & 19:00.

Marco (SF Hub): Nice — who is eligible? contractors? parking permit folks?

Ava (People Ops): Eligibility: W2 employees with >=1 onsite day/month. Contractors, vendors, and temps are not eligible for stipend. If you have an existing parking permit you can still join shuttle but stipend priority goes to folks without parking. Full policy + FAQ here: https://intranet.redwood.example/commuter-faq

Jordan (Finance): Quick finance note — the $100 stipend is a taxable benefit and will appear on May paystubs. If you want shuttle access but prefer not to take taxable stipend, choose "shuttle-only" on the form.

Priya (EMEA): Will there be anything similar for EMEA/APAC hubs?

Ava (People Ops): Pilot is SF & PDX only for now. Were collecting interest and usage data — if enough uptake we'll run a focused EMEA pilot in Q3. Please fill the short global interest survey from the link if youre outside NA.

Taylor: Can the stipend be used for micromobility (scooter/bikes) or is it transit-only? Also — where do we park bikes at SF hub?

Ava (People Ops): Stipend is flexible — transit pass, rideshare, micromobility, or commuter benefits program. SF hub has new secured bike racks by the loading dock; Facilities will post photos in #people-ops later today.

Leo (People Ops): Shuttle seat policy: priority to employees without parking permits. If capacity remains, we open seats 3 days before each week to all signups. If you sign up and cant make it, please cancel so someone else can take the seat.

Emily: If I sign up mid-month and then switch to a remote week, how is stipend handled?

Jordan (Finance): Stipend is pro-rated monthly based on eligible status at payroll cutoff. We'll publish examples (1 day onsite vs 10 days onsite) in the FAQ doc.

Ava (People Ops): We'll host a 30-min drop-in next Wednesday 10:00am PT to walk through the form, tax treatment, and shuttle logistics. Calendar invite sent to #people-ops and the pilot signup auto-populates the shuttle waitlist. RSVP recommended. @here :wave:

TransitBot: Event posted: "Commuter Flex info drop-in (Ava)" 2025-04-30 10:00 PDT.

Ava (People Ops): Thanks all — lemme know if you want the stipend opt-out code for Finance or need a direct DM for special accommodations (accessible seating on shuttle, stroller space, etc.).
